Privacy Policy

The short version: we don't want your data, so we mostly don't collect it.

Last updated: September 13, 2026

FinitePlay LLC ("FinitePlay," "we," "us") builds apps and games that are free to download and use, with no ads, no accounts, and no behavioral tracking. This policy explains what little information is involved when you visit finiteplay.org or use an official FinitePlay app, and why.

This website

finiteplay.org contains no analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts, and it does not use cookies. We do not know who visits this site or what you do while you're here.

Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, automatically processes standard technical information to deliver the site and keep it secure — for example, your IP address, browser type, and the pages requested, retained briefly in server logs. We do not have access to build a profile from these logs, and we do not combine them with any other data.

If you email us (for example, at contact@finiteplay.org), we receive whatever you choose to include in that message. We use it only to respond to you and do not add you to any mailing list or share it with third parties.

Our apps

Official FinitePlay apps are built to work offline whenever possible and do not require an account to use. They do not contain advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, or other third-party trackers, and they do not collect or transmit information about how you use them.

Where an app needs a device permission or an internet connection to do its job (for example, to check for updates or to enable an optional feature you choose to use), we explain why in the app itself before you grant it. Any app-specific detail that isn't covered by this general policy will be disclosed in that app's own listing or in-app notice.

We do not sell personal information, and we never will — there is nothing to sell in the first place.

Children's privacy

Because we don't collect personal information through this site or our apps, we don't knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us information through direct correspondence (such as email), contact us and we will delete it.

Changes to this policy

If our practices change — for instance, if a future app needs to handle information differently — we will update this page and, where appropriate, the app itself, before the change takes effect.

Contact

Questions about this policy or how a specific app works can be sent to contact@finiteplay.org.
